Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Canopi's create-collection sheet - tapping the orange New Collection button springs a dark bottom sheet up over the dimmed home screen, its template list items staggering in one after another.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark home screen ("Hey 60fps" greeting, a collection card, tagline copy, orange "+ New Collection" pill). On tap: the home screen dims to ~40% and a near-black sheet with rounded top corners slides up to about 85% height, titled "Create Collection". Inside, a list of template rows: Upcoming Trip, Birthday Present Ideas, Parties & Celebrations, Empty Collection - each with a small thumbnail, title, and sub-line.

## Motion spec
Pattern: spring bottom sheet with staggered row entry.
- The sheet slides up with a spring (stiffness ~280, damping ~26) - fast rise, one gentle settle, no bounce past its final height.
- The backdrop dims in sync with the sheet's travel (opacity mapped to translation).
- Rows stagger in from below: each translates ~16px up and fades in (250ms, ease-out), 60ms apart, starting as the sheet passes ~50% of its travel.
- The sheet's grabber area and title are part of the sheet body - they arrive with it, not with the row stagger.
- Drag down dismisses with the sheet tracking the finger 1:1, then falling away (or snapping back if released above the halfway point, spring back).

## Calibration
- One settle on entry; visible bouncing makes a utility sheet feel flimsy.
- Row stagger must start mid-travel so the sheet never sits open and empty.

## Reduced motion
Sheet fades in at final position (200ms); rows appear with it.

## Don't miss
- The orange button is the only warm accent on the dark home - the sheet itself is monochrome.
- Rows keep their thumbnails and sub-lines; it is a template picker, not a plain text list.
